chunks: (Remember) her who preserved her chastity, into whom We breathed a new life from Us, and made her and her son a token for mankind.
ai.seo_question: Who is the woman referred to as a sign for mankind in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Maryam’s (peace be upon her) spiritual perfection and purity, serving as a model of devotion and the vessel for the divine spirit (Ruh) that animated Jesus. The designation of both mother and son as an 'ayah' (sign) highlights their miraculous birth and unique status in creation, affirming the power of God to create without a father. This narrative reinforces the Shia emphasis on the purity of the Ahl al-Bayt lineage and the divine selection of key figures in salvation history.
